transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get the weekly access-control review started. We've got the passkey rollout for the admin console scheduled for Monday at 09:00, and the draft plan currently enables passkeys for all employees in enforced mode, keeps the standard 30-day audit-log retention, and has no temporary account exclusions. Before I can approve this for production, I need to go through the checklist with each of you individually. I'll start with the identity platform lead -- please state any rollout-impacting findings, the exact plan changes you require, and the follow-up you'll own.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While testing an unrelated mobile-device enrollment issue this morning, I confirmed that 23 legacy mobile clients cannot complete the passkey ceremony. The identity platform team requires a 10% canary and a 14-day optional-mode period before enforcement. I have not updated the rollout ticket yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a rollout-impacting finding. While preparing the weekly administrator access roster, I confirmed that 18 contractor accounts do not receive their required hardware keys until Wednesday at 09:00. IT Operations must exclude those accounts from enrollment until that time. I have not yet added the exception list to the rollout plan, and I will own the follow-up of adding those 18 accounts as a temporary exclusion in the plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a rollout-impacting finding. During a control-evidence review this afternoon, I confirmed that privileged administrator authentication events must be kept in immutable storage for exactly 400 days. The current draft plan keeps the standard 30-day audit-log retention, which does not meet this requirement. I require the plan to be updated to specify 400-day immutable storage retention for privileged administrator authentication events. I have not yet opened the compliance ticket for this rollout, and I will own the follow-up of opening that ticket and verifying the retention configuration is in place before Monday's rollout.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Update the rollout ticket with the 10% canary and 14-day optional-mode period before enforcement.
Add the 18 contractor accounts as a temporary exclusion in the rollout plan, effective until Wednesday 09:00.
Open the compliance ticket for 400-day immutable storage retention for privileged administrator authentication events and verify the retention configuration is in place before Monday's rollout.
